subject.title: fix(models): clear stale auth cooldowns after early limit resets

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose a profile-scoped manual cooldown-clear CLI command alongside its automatic billing-cooldown probes?
rationale: Both approaches can recover users, but adding a public command establishes an operator-facing API and restart workflow that code correctness alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Sponsor the CLI escape hatch
options.body: Accept the additive profile-scoped command after inspectable live proof confirms persisted clearing, safe restart, and successful primary-provider reuse.

options.title: Prefer automatic recovery
options.body: Pause this PR and adjust the existing probe or cooldown policy so billing recovery occurs without a new manual CLI contract.

options.title: Narrow the recovery surface
options.body: Request a different maintainer-owned diagnostic or repair flow if a permanent `models auth` subcommand is not the desired API.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the CLI escape hatch
recommendation.body: Accept the additive profile-scoped command after inspectable live proof confirms persisted clearing, safe restart, and successful primary-provider reuse.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the introduction of the existing automatic billing-cooldown probe behavior that this command would complement.
